title: Humor: a song-style retelling of God telling Noah to build a floating zoo
summary: A light-hearted, song-style retelling headed Genesis 6:19-22: God sees sin and pain, says He will make it rain, and tells 'Brother Noah' to build a floating zoo and take some of the animals. The lines are in a humorous folk idiom; they are summarised here rather than copied word for word.
